headline: Your messy business problem.
lede: I’m Bogdan. I build data systems, AI agents, and automations that turn scattered information and repetitive work into clear answers and things getting done.
about: I'm Bogdan. I bring concepts to life — through technology, and through people.

There's a long process behind most of what I make, and I like it that way. In Winnipeg, at an ingredient company, I turned a scattered global licensing network into infrastructure you can actually query — work that used to live in four inboxes and a shared drive now lives in one system. Data pipelines, AI agents, CRM architecture. If it's repetitive, I'd rather build the thing that does it than do it twice.

The same instinct shows up behind a camera. I fly GPS and FPV, shoot and cut short-form, and build scenes in 3D — filming and modelling are the same job to me: you're constructing something that didn't exist, framing it, and making someone feel it. I train Muay Thai. I play Magic.

Mostly I like to be useful to people, and the people I most want to be useful to are here. I've lived in Winnipeg ten years. I want to bring more of the world to this city, and more of this city to the world. БОГMODE is where the systems, the stories, and the people meet.

contact.formIntro: A project to move forward, or a role that needs someone to build and own systems? Tell me about the challenge, the team, and what a useful result would look like.
